question: At the next completed service, which maintenance tasks will be performed?

landmark.definition: end-of-month observation point for one motorcycle

target_service.definition: first service with received_at strictly after landmark_at, within the motorcycle's administrative observation window
target_service.completion_semantics: every services.csv row in v1.4 has status=DELIVERED; arrival implies completion (median 1.3h, 90.7% same calendar day)

target_label.definition: task_code on the target service with service_tasks.status = COMPLETED
target_label.applicability: taxonomy powertrain / final_drive / cooling / transmission requirements vs the motorcycle's model spec

event_type_decisions.workshop_inspection: COUNTS as labels where INSPECT tasks are recorded; there is no separate inspection-only service type in v1.4
event_type_decisions.filter_replacement: COUNTS (AIR_FILTER_CHANGE modelled; OIL_FILTER_CHANGE and FUEL_FILTER_* excluded on support - see AMBIGUOUS notes)
event_type_decisions.chain_service: COUNTS (CHAIN_CLEAN / CHAIN_LUBRICATE / CHAIN_INSPECTION), applicable only to chain-drive motorcycles
event_type_decisions.brake_work: COUNTS (pad inspect/change, fluid check/change, disc, bleed)
event_type_decisions.coolant: COUNTS (COOLANT_LEVEL_CHECK / COOLANT_CHANGE), applicable to liquid-cooled only
event_type_decisions.clutch: EXCLUDED on support - only 1,898 applicable rows (manual-transmission bikes) and <200 pre-TEST positives
event_type_decisions.valve_inspection: COUNTS (VALVE_CLEARANCE_INSPECTION modelled, VALVE_CLEARANCE_ADJUST modelled as low-frequency)
event_type_decisions.breakdown_repair: The service COUNTS as a target service (service_type_code=BREAKDOWN, 1,664 services). Its task lines are labels like any other. V3 predicts what will be done at the next visit, whatever kind of visit it is.
event_type_decisions.warranty_service: COUNTS. NOTE: in v1.4 is_warranty == is_breakdown exactly (both 1,664 rows) - warranty is not an independent event type in this world.
event_type_decisions.cancellation: CANNOT be a target - CANCELLED appointments (2,552) never produce a service row
event_type_decisions.no_show: CANNOT be a target - NO_SHOW appointments (2,052) never produce a service row
event_type_decisions.appointment_without_completion: CANNOT be a target - only CONVERTED_TO_SERVICE appointments (30,901) reach services.csv; RESCHEDULED (844) do not

unresolved_semantics: OIL_FILTER_CHANGE is decoupled from ENGINE_OIL_CHANGE in this generator (40 vs 34,762 positives). Real workshops almost always pair them. Marked AMBIGUOUS; not modelled.
is_warranty is perfectly collinear with is_breakdown, so 'warranty service' has no independent meaning in v1.4 and no separate contract line can be established from data.
There is no explicit service_type for a pure inspection visit; inspection tasks appear inside PERIODIC/REPAIR services.
